The '''Brouwer Medal''' is a triennial award presented by the [[Royal Dutch Mathematical Society]] and the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Sciences]]. The Brouwer Metal gets its name from Dutch mathematician [[L. E. J. Brouwer]] and is the Netherlands’ most prestigious award in mathematics.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.utwente.nl/ewi/nmc2011/en/brouwer/ |title=The Brouwer Lecture and the Brouwer Medal |publisher=Utwente.nl |date=2 February 2014 |accessdate=25 April 2014 |archive-date=10 May 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170510094128/http://www.utwente.nl/ewi/nmc2011/en/brouwer/ |url-status=dead }}</ref>
